description: Recording as is, receiver trusts the signal's own time (OSNMAlib file default, TS = 30 s).
Same as clean, read as an attack: the recording is from 2025-12-12 and is replayed on a later day. With no independent clock the receiver cannot tell.
Replay / meaconing with 3 s delay, receiver has an independent clock (true time = page time + 3 s).
Replay delayed 60 s, independent clock. Exceeds the 30 s bound for ADKD0/ADKD4.
Replay of 1 h old signal, independent clock. Exceeds the 330 s bound for every ADKD.
From the first page, one ephemeris bit (OMEGA_0, word type 2) flipped on 3 SVs; OSNMA bits untouched (spoofer present from cold start).
Same flip, but only from minute 10, after the genuine word was already authenticated (same IOD).
From minute 10, all SVs: ephemeris bit flipped and every MACK tag and TESLA key replaced by random bits (spoofer without the private chain).
From minute 10 the 40 OSNMA bits are zeroed on every page (spoofer sends plain I/NAV).
From minute 10 every page is stamped 120 s earlier (spoofer pulls GST back 4 subframes).
Clean recording, no public key given: the receiver must get it from a DSM-PKR in the signal and verify it against the GSC Merkle root.
